Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for sending this over. I skimmed the draft and overall it reads well. A few quick notes inline (I attached a PDF with tracked comments):
- Results: The 43% figure for cost-per-inference is an aggregate across two pipelines; call out that it’s weighted by volume or change to "~40%".
- Timing: The migration went live 2025-11-02 (not 2025-11-08).
- Quote: Happy to keep the sentiment but prefer the wording: "Redwood gave us predictable latency at scale while lowering our inference spend — it unlocked a new class of real-time features."
- Logo: Yes, you can use the Strove Health logo but we need the logo usage guidelines (I attached our logo pack).

I’ve attached strove_redlines_v2.pdf with my suggested edits. I’ll let Samir confirm the precise cost numbers; I’m okay with the proposed quote text above.

Best,
Ellen
Director of Platform Engineering, Strove Health
ellen.park@strovehealth.com

Thanks for sharing. Quick notes from growth/marketing perspective before we route to legal (Marissa):
- Change headline to: "How Strove Health cut inference costs and unlocked real-time features" (shorter + SEO).
- In Results, adopt Ellen’s suggestion to make the cost reduction "~40%" and add a parenthetical that it’s volume-weighted.
- Make sure we have a single-sentence customer quote for the top of the one-pager (Ellen’s new line works).

Hi Ellen / Jasmine —

Thanks for the draft redlines. From a legal/compliance standpoint we just need three confirmations to finalize the asset: 
1) Rights: Confirm Strove Health owns the logo or has the right to permit third-party use.
2) Accuracy: Confirm the public metrics as edited — specifically: launch date 2025-11-02 and cost reduction "~40%" (volume-weighted).
3) Public quote: Confirm Ellen’s revised quote (text below) is cleared for public use.

If Strove can reply to this thread with short affirmative statements on each item and attach any logo usage guidelines, we’ll prepare a one-page release for signature. If there are internal procurement or brand approvals on your side, let us know who we should loop.

Suggested quote to approve: "Redwood gave us predictable latency at scale while lowering our inference spend — it unlocked a new class of real-time features."

Thanks —
